394-3240-6462-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5256-8175.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

2607-7450.description:
Cast Pox Plague by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}, causing each player to lose half their life, discard half their hand, and sacrifice half their permanents, rounded down. Ensure that you don't sacrifice Archfiend of Despair.
At the beginning of your end step, Archfiend of Despair triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they've lost this turn.
2607-7450.notes: Each opponent with an odd life total will have 1 life remaining. Each opponent with an even life total will have 0 life and lose the game.

3705-5231-6896-7316.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

3817-4605-5256-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2099-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

622-4365-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-4365-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

4067-5116-5181-6281.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Golgari Findbroker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Golgari Findbroker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Golgari Findbroker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Golgari Findbroker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

2292-4446-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
2292-4446-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with six or more +1/+1 counters on it

645-2060-3750-5686-6835.notablePrerequisites: Alesha cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
645-2060-3750-5686-6835.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

325-602-4444-6282.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
325-602-4444-6282.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Toluz trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat.

277-1479-5700-5701-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5700-5701-6529.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1339-2438-3284.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2438-3284.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-2438-4871-5111.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-2438-4871-5111.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1548-1550-4359.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to Garna.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Garna and Port Razer.
Garna does not have summoning sickness.
1548-1550-4359.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Garna and Port Razer, triggering Sword of Hearth and Home and Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, exiling Port Razer, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Port Razer onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2152-3769-4691.notablePrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2152-3769-4691.description:
Attack with Blim, dealing combat damage to an opponent.
Blim triggers, giving that player control of Vilis and causing each player to lose life and discard cards equal to the number of permanents they control but don't own.
Vilis triggers, causing that player to draw cards equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Fate Unraveler triggers, dealing 1 damage to that player.
Repeat from step 4.
